'''January 2005 Coronado tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Saturday 8 January 2005 in the Winn Room of the Coronado Public Library, 640 Orange Ave., Coronado (San Diego), California, run by [[Steve Sanders|Stephen Sanders]].<ref name="pcf-4290-58925">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58925#58925 Southern California -FINALLY], Steve Sanders (Shran), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 December 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050213133831/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59670%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Play began at noon. It was four rounds with an unlimited card pool; entry was free, and players were asked to bring a ''Star Wars'' CCG pack for prize support.<ref name="pcf-4290-58925" /> Jaymin Vaghashia won from a field of nine players.<ref name="pcf-4290-59670">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59670#59670 Southern California -FINALLY], Steve Sanders (Shran), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050213133831/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59670%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

After the event Sanders asked every player for their Decipher player ID number, which Decipher's new prize-support system required.<ref name="pcf-4290-59670" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Winn Room, Coronado Public Library, 640 Orange Ave., Coronado, California<ref name="pcf-4290-58925" />
* '''Dates:''' 8 January 2005<ref name="pcf-4290-58925" /><ref name="pcf-4290-59670" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, unlimited card pool, four rounds<ref name="pcf-4290-58925" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Sanders|Stephen Sanders]]<ref name="pcf-4290-58925" />
* '''Players:''' 9<ref name="pcf-4290-59670" />
* '''Winner:''' Jaymin Vaghashia<ref name="pcf-4290-59670" />
